new_value: {"notes":"2026-11-18, Mark's decision as relayed by ietf-dd: deferred to after the interop day; do it only if a real peer hits the mls-rs default-identity-provider problem. mls-rs finding (rev d9af950): the default tree_index feature rejects a second leaf whose identity is already in the tree with DuplicateLeafData (tree_index.rs:161, 176-178; without the feature tree_index.rs:108-114); identity is what the IdentityProvider returns, and BasicIdentityProvider returns the raw BasicCredential identifier (identity/basic.rs:83-89). An mls-rs app with its own IdentityProvider returning a per-client identity would not hit it."}
